app.title: Operation Base
app.subtitle: 6 weeks
app.rule: The winner is not whoever did the hardest workout, but whoever did not break the chain in 42 days.

chain.title: Daily chain
chain.description: Done every single day, no exceptions.
chain.hourlyWalksHint: Stand up and walk 3 min once per hour of work

program.startDateHint: The weekly cycle runs Mon–Sun, so a Monday start lines up best.
program.startFailed: Could not start the program. Try again.

session.painHint: Sharp pain in a knee, lower back, elbow or heel — stop that exercise for the day.
session.readyToStepUp: 5×15 felt easy — you can take {weight} kg.
session.unlockAvailable: Condition met — you can start the next progression.

benchmarks.title: Entry benchmark
benchmarks.enterStart: Record your starting numbers before day 1.
benchmarks.enterEnd: Repeat the same tests and record the result.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: We'll email you a sign-in link — no password needed.

errors.invalid_link: That link was incomplete. Request a new email.
errors.expired_link: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.otp_expired: That link has expired or was already used. Each new email cancels the previous ones — open the most recent.
errors.access_denied: The link was rejected. Request a new email.
errors.pkce_verifier_missing: Open the link in the same browser you requested it from.
errors.generic: Sign-in failed. Request a new link.

settings.exportHint: Everything you've logged, as one JSON file. Six weeks of work shouldn't stay locked in someone else's database.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.generic: Try again. If it keeps happening, reload the page.
errors.misconfigured: The app isn't connected to its database. Check NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY in your deployment settings.
